title: How to Go Live with Squarespace Website, Can I Publish My Squarespace Website for free in 2026?
description:
Here I will show you How to Go Live with Squarespace Website, And also answer the common question: Can I Publish My Squarespace Website for free in 2026?

"Hey everyone, here is how to go live with Squarespace website step-by-step — whether you’re launching for the first time or looking to publish your Squarespace website after editing.

You have worked hard on your Squarespace site — pat your back, and now it’s packed with content, beautifully designed, and ready to be shared with the world. Well, today is the day you finally make your Squarespace site live for everyone to see. And the best part? It’ll only take about 3-4 minutes.

Step 1: Log into Squarespace
Head over to the Squarespace homepage. This is where your journey to launching your website on Squarespace begins. Click the Login button at the top-right of the page. You’ll be taken to the sign-in screen.

If you use Google services, click Continue with Google for a faster sign-in. Choose the Google account linked to your site. This makes the process quick and password-free.

Step 2: Access Your Dashboard
Once logged in, you’ll land on your Squarespace dashboard, which lists all your websites. Click on the site you want to go live with. This step is the beginning of taking your design from draft to public.

Step 3: Navigate to Site Settings
On your dashboard, find the Settings menu. Use the left-hand navigation if needed. Inside Settings, click on Website — this section contains all the options needed to make your website public on Squarespace.

Step 4: Adjust Site Availability
Under Website Settings, find Site Availability. This is where you control who can view your website. If your site is private or new, you’ll see a button labeled Upgrade to Publish.

Clicking this will take you to Squarespace’s plans page. This is an essential step in the process to publish your Squarespace site after designing.

Step 5: Choose a Plan and Checkout
Select the plan that suits your goals — from personal to business websites. Don’t worry, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime. Then proceed to checkout and enter your payment details securely.

Once payment is complete, your website will go live immediately. Your Squarespace site will be visible to the world — accessible via the domain connected to your account. If you haven’t done so already, now’s the perfect time to connect your domain to Squarespace.

Final Checks Before Publishing
Before you click Upgrade to Publish, give your website one last check. Look for typos, broken links, or missing images. This is your final polish before your Squarespace website launch.

And that’s it — you’ve just learned how to go live with Squarespace website, including all the essential settings and final steps to make your site public on Squarespace.

If this tutorial helped you, don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe for more tips"

title: How To Fix Instagram We Restrict Certain Activity, Temporary Blocked Error 2026
description:
Hello everyone, here is How To Fix Instagram We Restrict Certain Activity, Temporary Blocked Error 2026.

In this video, I’m going to show you how to fix the Instagram error message that says: "We restrict certain activity to protect our community."

If you're getting this Instagram action blocked error, just follow the steps I’m going to show you to remove it.

As you can see, this is how the error usually appears:
“Try again later. We restrict certain activity to protect our community.”

This issue often happens when you're spamming comments on Instagram, sending too many messages, or performing actions too quickly—what Instagram considers suspicious activity.

If you want to fix this Instagram restriction problem, here are some simple solutions:

Wait it out –
Sometimes the best fix for this Instagram temporary block is just waiting. After a short time, try commenting or messaging again, and it should work.

Log out and log back in –
Logging out can help reset your activity.

Go to your profile.

Tap the top-right icon.

Scroll down and under Login, tap Log Out or Log Out All Accounts.

Sign back in to check if the Instagram try again later error is gone.

Restart your phone –
This can fix minor bugs that may be causing the Instagram we restrict activity error.

Clear your Instagram cache –

Open Settings.

Go to Apps or Applications.

Search for Instagram.

Tap on it, scroll to Storage, and tap Clear Cache.
This can help fix the we restrict certain activity Instagram bug.

That’s it for today’s video. If you're still facing the Instagram restriction message, try these steps over time to regain full access.

Thanks for watching, and I’ll see you in the next one!
